The opening through 11.67 seconds is preserved. A single curve matches the incoming spatial velocity, passes through the doorway and ends forward enlargement at 17.67 seconds, retaining a gentle sideways drift. Krea Turbo repaints the warped previous image with staged descriptions of the meadow. CFG 1, three Euler intervals, 24 fps source at cadence 12. Delivery is 1.5× faster at 24 fps: three paintings per displayed second. RIFE 4.25 scale 1 is presentation only; seven final frames continue actual spatial warps.
